messages:
incident-bot: 🔔 ALERT: Hosted API queue length > 18,000 (us-west-2). p95 1.2s -> 18s, p99 3s -> 42s. Autoscaler failed to provision new GPU nodes: 6 consecutive timeouts. Paging @ryan (oncall).
ryan (oncall): on it — pulling up dashboards. Is this tied to marketing campaign traffic?
sre-jess: looking at routing, we have heatmaps showing a sudden fanout from a handful of API keys starting at 17:12 UTC. Not a region-wide DNS issue.
carla-cs: customer reports increased timeouts (multiple enterprise customers). CS triage says 5 customers have raised tickets.
eng-provisioner: seeing provisioner logs: 
```
E Provisioner: failed to create instance: APICallTimeout
E Provisioner: rate-limited by cloud provider; 429s and create calls queued
```
Trying to repro the 429 spike.
ryan (oncall): ok — mitigation options: 1) throttle incoming requests per-key, 2) enable fallback routing to smaller quantized model pool, 3) emergency spin up thin-provision pool in another region. Which is quickest?
sre-jess: quickest is per-key throttling + fallback routing. We can flip the routing rule in ~2m. Throttle rules live at `routing/hosted/limits`.
ops-ami: I can flip the throttle for the top offending API keys. Send me the keys.
carla-cs: keys are: `cust-acme-prod`, `cust-bluebird-1`, `cust-labs-batch`. I'll DM the exact keys (sensitive).
infra-bot: note: autoscaler leader election showed 10s lag before trying a retry; cloud quota errors at 17:21:03.
ryan (oncall): applying soft throttle (20% reduction) to the 3 keys now. Will monitor queue.
ryan (oncall): `curl -XPOST https://internal-routing/limits -d '{"key":"cust-acme-prod","rate":0.8}'` (pushed) — confirm?
eng-provisioner: confirmed request reached edge. Provisioner still returning `APICallTimeout` for new instance creation. Probably cloud-side API rate limiting.
sre-jess: also enabling fallback routing so lower-tier quantized models accept overflow traffic. Command: `PATCH /routing/policy` with body `{ "overflow": "quant-16g" }`. Doing it now.
ryan (oncall): applied. Queue length p95 dropping from 18k -> 8k after throttle + fallback. p99 still high ~22s.
carla-cs: customer impact update: 5 customers affected, priority-high. Some reports of 500s and aborted jobs. We notified enterprise contacts.
eng-provisioner: cloud provider replied with delayed quota window; they allowed a small burst — provisioning slowly progressing. New thin instances entering pool (2/8).
ryan (oncall): spinning up cross-region fallback ready to test: start `us-west-2 -> us-east-1` redirect rule to low-latency compatible models. Will do gradual 10% shift.
ops-ami: started shift. Watch for head-of-line latencies.
infra-bot: trace: `request_id=abc123` showed 30s waiting for queue slot before dispatch.
sre-jess: suggested longer-term fix: increase provisioner exponential backoff cap and implement jitter to avoid thundering retries during quota flaps. Filing an action.
ryan (oncall): also enabling circuit-breaker to return fast 503 for requests >120s in queue to reduce waste. Pushing rule now.
eng-provisioner: new nodes are up: +5 GPUs over last 12m. Autoscaler health shows `ready=true`.
ryan (oncall): queue now ~2.1k, p95 2.1s, p99 6.7s. Still degraded but improving.
carla-cs: customers notified: initial apology + mitigation plan. CS to follow up with RCA when done.
sre-jess: creating incident page and tagging postmortem owners: @sre-jess, @eng-provisioner, @ryan (oncall). Runbook executed: `hosted-queue-throttle-v2`.
eng-provisioner: root cause preliminary: provisioner made repeated create calls without respecting cloud provider effective quota window after previous burst; cloud returned transient 429/504. Provisioner retried aggressively causing backlog in control-plane requests.
ryan (oncall): handoff to night oncall @ops-ami in 20m. Summarize for handoff: throttles + fallbacks enabled, added 5 GPUs, cross-region shift 10%, circuit-breaker enabled, customers notified. Monitor queue and cloud quota errors.
ops-ami: ack — will monitor. If queue spikes again, plan B is to bump fallback ratio to 30% and coordinate with cloud support to raise quota temporarily.
infra-bot: incident-bot: created incident INC-2026-0457; severity: SEV2; timeline capture enabled.
carla-cs: logging customer case IDs against incident for billing/regression review.
ryan (oncall): leaving handoff notes in the incident doc: `-- mitigation log -- throttle keys applied 17:24 UTC; fallback patch 17:26 UTC; circuit-breaker 17:28 UTC; +5 GPUs 17:34 UTC; cross-region 17:36 UTC`.
ops-ami: following up — I'll keep the channel open for any escalations. Good job team. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: reminder: please run the initial impact survey and attach the prompt/traffic sample for evals before closing the incident."
